content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Guides gumroad

This is a sovereign commerce infrastructure, a base-layer solution that allows digital creators to sell PDF guides without relying on Stripe or PayPal. It's not a workaround or a temporary fix, but a permanent alternative that gives you full control over your online store and your customers' payment processing. By using this infrastructure, you can sell digital products without worrying about restrictions or account suspensions.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture is based on a combination of free and paid tools that work together seamlessly. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages host your online store, while Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle the backend logic. Supabase or Google Sheets store your orders, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 deliver your digital products to your customers. NOWPayments handles automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, with a 0.5% fee and no KYC or buyer account required.
Who This Is Built For and Why

NOWPayments operates as a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 cryptocurrencies including Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT on multiple chains, Solana, BNB on Binance Smart Chain, and Tron. When a buyer initiates payment, NOWPayments creates a unique payment address for that specific transaction, monitors the blockchain in real time, and fires a webhook when payment confirms on-chain. The 0.5% fee is the only cost — no monthly fee, no setup fee, no revenue share, no payout schedule. Funds go directly to the wallet addresses you configure. COREMERCH never touches your wallet or your funds at any point before, during, or after deployment.
Stripe operates in only 46 countries, leaving millions of digital creators locked out.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The asymmetric risk of platform dependency becomes concrete only when the platform acts. While a PayPal or Stripe account is functioning normally, the risk feels theoretical and distant. When it stops functioning — through suspension, policy change, or geographic restriction enforcement — the creator loses their revenue channel instantly, often with funds already inside the platform that cannot be withdrawn. The conventional appeals process rarely reverses these decisions because the original decision was made algorithmically and the human review process operates on the platform's timeline and criteria, not yours. Sovereign infrastructure eliminates this asymmetry entirely. Your Cloudflare Pages storefront cannot be suspended by a payment processor's compliance decision. Your wallet cannot be frozen by anyone.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy today, start by choosing the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), which includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. Deploy Stack 02 in 48 hours, load 5 products, configure SPF/DKIM/DMARC, and test end-to-end before handoff. You can also purchase the Sovereign Blueprint or the Complete Builder Kit for more detailed documentation and source code. Once you have your infrastructure set up, you can start selling digital products without relying on Stripe or PayPal.

With this sovereign commerce infrastructure, you can take back control of your online store and your customers' payment processing, and sell digital products without worrying about restrictions or account suspensions.
A PayPal account suspension can hold your funds for up to 180 days with no appeal.

If you're looking for a permanent alternative to Gumroad, this is it. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is a comprehensive solution that includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. You can also check out our products at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, including the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) and the Complete Builder Kit ($197).
Your Deployment Checklist

Accept that no workaround inside conventional payment infrastructure is durable — platforms actively close gaps as they discover them. Create a NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as your starting point — these cover the widest range of buyers in restricted markets. Choose your stack: Stack 01 for a self-deployed free setup using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, Stack 02 for the Edge Stack deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint URL in your IPN settings pointing to your backend. Upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the full pipeline: webhook received, transaction verified on-chain, order logged, delivery email sent, download link working. Share your store URL only after the mainnet test passes cleanly.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the difference between a workaround and a permanent alternative?

A workaround is a temporary fix that may not be reliable or scalable, while a permanent alternative is a structural solution that gives you full control over your online store and your customers' payment processing.
Can I use this infrastructure to sell physical products?
No, this infrastructure is designed specifically for selling digital products. However, you can use it to sell physical products through our sister company, Corephysical.
What is the 0.5% fee for NOWPayments?

The 0.5% fee is a flat rate for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. This is a one-time fee for each transaction, and it's a fraction of the cost of using conventional payment processing systems.
Can I use this infrastructure with my existing e-commerce platform?
No, this infrastructure is designed to be a standalone solution that replaces your existing e-commerce platform. However, you can integrate it with your existing platform using our API.
What is the best way to handle refunds and chargebacks with this infrastructure?
Refunds and chargebacks are handled automatically through the NOWPayments system. You can also set up custom refund and chargeback policies through our dashboard.
